description: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon Level 60 Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands. Requirements: - Severed Horn of the Defiler
name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
